text: In May 2022 a panel of 18 people recommended that Adam Silvera's More Happy Than Not remain in the school district's libraries. A conservative group had complained to the PCPS superintendent that it was among 16 books that contained pornography or were harmful to children. The panel was split on the grade level at which the book should be available.
meta_description: More Happy Than Not by Adam Silvera: in May 2022 a panel of 18 recommended it stay in school libraries after a conservative group's complaint.
